summary: Independent verifier checked TASK-0038 against the task contract, authority docs, manifests, implementation boundary, SG-8 smoke evidence, focused tests, CLI smoke, lint, and full repository baseline. Every acceptance criterion has sufficient evidence.

criteria.criterion: A project-specific GoalExecutionRequest validates without importing dynamic_fixture.py.
criteria.notes: GoalExecutionRequest validation is covered by the implementation report and test_goal_validate_does_not_import_dynamic_fixture.

criteria.criterion: goal plan produces acceptance artifacts, PlanDraft validation and admitted PlanIR without executing Nodes.
criteria.notes: SG-8 plan output includes request, PlanDraft, validation report, and admitted PlanIR with executedNodeCount 0.

criteria.criterion: goal start creates a durable GoalExecution and begins the same service path used by tests.
criteria.notes: goal start creates durable GoalExecution and PlanExecution state through GoalOperationService and shared scheduler path.

criteria.criterion: goal inspect reports Goal/Plan/Node/Gate/Evidence/Defect/capability state and metrics.
criteria.notes: goal inspect reports GoalExecution, PlanExecution, NodeRun, Evidence, capability grant, artifact finding, and metrics data.

criteria.criterion: goal resume continues from SQLite in a new process.
criteria.notes: Resume was exercised in a new Python process from SQLite state and completed without duplicating completed work.

criteria.criterion: goal cancel propagates through GoalExecution, PlanExecution and active NodeRuns.
criteria.notes: GoalOperationService.cancel delegates PlanExecution cancellation, and plan execution tests cover propagation to active and pending NodeRuns.

criteria.criterion: Unknown profiles, adapters, drivers, stores and runtime refs fail closed with structured errors.
criteria.notes: Negative cases cover invalid digest, legacy profile, unknown planner, executor, gate runner, runtime, missing SQLite, duplicate start, terminal cancel, and missing artifact inspect.

criteria.criterion: The CLI contains no direct NodeExecutor or GateRunner orchestration.
criteria.notes: CLI goal handlers instantiate GoalOperationService and do not directly orchestrate NodeExecutor or GateRunner.

criteria.criterion: Default docs and Skill identify the generic Goal path while retaining the old fixture as regression-only.
criteria.notes: README, framework entrypoints, component inventory, and dynamic-kernel Skill identify ahra goal as the default generic path and fixture dynamic-repair as regression-only.

criteria.criterion: SG-8 generic durable operation smoke passes.
criteria.notes: SG-8 smoke summary passed with resumed succeeded status, 2 succeeded NodeRuns, 2 Evidence refs, 1 capability grant, 0 missing artifacts, and terminal cancel failing closed.

commands.command: uv run python -B -m unittest tests.test_goal_operations tests.test_cli -v
uv run ahra goal validate examples/m1/goal-run-request.yaml
commands.notes: Console-script GoalExecutionRequest validation returned ok true and valid true.
AHRA lint reported 0 failures and AWKP lint reported 0 errors, 0 warnings.
